_comment: Backyard Brawl QA run. URL: http://localhost:3002/?hp=3&seed=1 (debug run: never writes the save; the fixed seed makes all 3 iterations identical, since about 0.7 % of random seeds survive this script with 3 HP). The game steps exactly 1/60 s per scripted frame (window.advanceTime test clock in main.js). Start from the title with Enter, Enter (Title -> Weapon Select -> Arena; from Results the first Enter replays), walk a square so bark kills a few cats (score > 0), then stand still (tapping 1 every 100 frames picks the first card if a level-up is open): with 3 HP the cats knock Booker out (death beat 1.1 s) -> Results (mode game_over). 1483 frames per iteration.

steps._comment: Enter: Title -> Weapon Select (from Results: Play Again -> Arena)
Weapon Select settles (menus ignore keys for 120 ms after opening)
Enter: Start (bark) -> Arena. From Results this Enter lands in the Arena and does nothing
Stand still until knocked out -> Results; Digit1 picks card 1 if a level-up is open
